subject: Aligning demo timing — procurement intake outstanding
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@crescentbio.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-19T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Aligning demo timing — procurement intake outstanding

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for taking the time to talk last week. Per our conversation, we'd like to schedule a 30-minute technical demo (30 min demo + 15 min buffer for Q&A) to walk your product and infra teams through the integration patterns and to cover data retention/security controls.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Wed Apr 26 — 11:00–11:45
- Thu Apr 27 — 14:00–14:45

If procurement requires pre-demo material, we can send our vendor security questionnaire and a standard mutual NDA ahead of time. I've attached a short pre-demo checklist to help your team prepare.

Can you confirm which slot works or if you'd prefer us to send the intake docs first?

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0126

Attachment: pre-demo-checklist.pdf
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@crescentbio.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Crescent Biotech Procurement <procurement@crescentbio.com>
Date: 2028-04-19T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Aligning demo timing — procurement intake outstanding

Hi Hannah —

Appreciate the options. Quick heads up — our procurement team requires a completed vendor security questionnaire and a signed NDA before we schedule technical vendor demos with our engineering team. I’ve cc'd procurement so they have visibility.

Rough timeline from procurement: about 7–10 business days to process the intake once we submit the docs. If you can share the questionnaire and NDA, we’ll route them today.

Procurement contact:
Maya Singh (procurement@crescentbio.com)

If the intake runs longer than a week, we may need to push the demo into mid-May — can you share the intake materials so I can get them moving?

Thanks,
Elena Torres
Head of Product, Crescent Biotech
elena.torres@crescentbio.com
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-19T10:23:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Aligning demo timing — procurement intake outstanding

Marissa / Karthik — see below from Elena. Procurement wants the questionnaire + NDA before the demo.

Marissa: can you push our intake docs and NDA to Elena and procurement today? If procurement asks for SOC-2 evidence or a short audit summary, we should be ready to share the one-pager.

Karthik: we tentatively had SE travel the week of Apr 24 for an on-site; if this demo slips to mid-May we’ll need to check his availability (or offer a remote deep-dive). Any constraints on your end between May 10–20?

I can offer Elena a calendar hold for May 14–16 as tentative dates if procurement needs the buffer.

— Hannah

Hi Elena / Procurement team —

Thanks for the heads up. Please find the following attached for intake and routing:
- Crescent_NDA_Redwood_v1.0.pdf (standard mutual NDA; editable)
- Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_Crescent.xlsx (completed where possible; some answers marked TBD for technical follow-up)
- pre-demo-checklist.pdf (reference)

Maya / Procurement: if you need a SOC 2 one-pager or the contact for our security lead to answer questionnaire deep-dive items, ping me and I’ll loop them in.

We expect procurement clearance to take ~7–14 business days depending on queue. To keep calendars tidy, Hannah suggested a tentative hold May 14–16 — happy to place a soft hold if that helps.

Next steps:
1) Procurement confirms receipt and expected timeline
2) Crescent returns signed NDA and completed questionnaire (we can accept partially completed with follow-up)
3) We finalize demo slot and invite SE for the deep-dive

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
